d:
Dakshin eshiya men prakritik aapdaen lagatar barh rahi hain. aise men COP31 se sauth eshiya ke deshon ko kya ummiden thin. kya dakshin eshiya men aa rahi in aapdaon ko lekar koee thos kadam uthae ja sakenge. dekhie bibisi ki sauth eshiya rijnal jarnalizam tim ki yah riport.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
